about: The coverage map. Seeded by tools/coverage_seed.nim from the Pele checkout (lines of TypeScript, tests, corpus cases); status, nim, post and notes are written by the pull request that ports a part. A status is planned, started, blocked or done; done means difftest finds the Nim output identical to Pele's, byte for byte, on that part's corpus.

stages.name: Parse
stages.what: Mermaid text to a model of the diagram

stages.name: Layout
stages.what: the model to positions and sizes

core.what: measuring text without a browser: font metrics, labels, entities
core.notes: Every file of src/text/ is ported (the metrics measurer, labels, entities, icons, math). Checked through pie: its titles and legend labels, in the corpus and in the fuzzer. Markdown labels, math, icons and wrapping wait for the types that use them.

core.what: writing SVG: the builder, shapes, edges, clusters, the palette and the theme
core.notes: builder.ts, palette.ts, theme.ts, ink.ts and root.ts are ported and checked through pie and timeline; shapes.ts, edges.ts, cluster.ts and title.ts through flowchart (layered-layout-and-flowchart).

core.what: the shared layouts: layered (Sugiyama), compound, lanes, components
core.notes: All four are ported. layered.ts and compound.ts are checked through flowchart (383 corpus cases, 5,000 generated in CI) and by Pele's 31 layout tests (tests/test_layout.nim); lanes.ts through swimlane (14 corpus cases, 5,000 generated in CI); components.ts through class (84 corpus cases, 5,000 generated in CI).

core.what: Unicode, URLs, a small YAML reader for front matter
core.notes: yaml.ts, chars.ts, unicode.ts and url.ts are ported; url.ts is checked through flowchart's links and images (international domain names are not converted to Punycode).

core.what: what several diagram types share: fitting text, scanning, icons
core.notes: tokens.ts (the Langium-style tokenizer), fit-width.ts, scan.ts (the Jison-style lexer rules journey and timeline share), fit.ts (plain labels, cut words), fit-text.ts (shrink, then cut with an ellipsis), literal-label.ts accDescr.ts (the accDescr terminal for grammars that keep lexing after an unclosed brace), outline.ts (the indented outline mindmap and kanban share) and icon.ts are ported.

core.what: detecting the type, preprocessing, render(), errors, the registry
core.notes: detect.ts, preprocess.ts, errors.ts, types.ts and core.ts render() are ported. detectType agrees with Pele on all 2,118 corpus inputs (tests/test_detect.nim). A type nimaki does not draw yet raises the code unsupported.

core.what: what only a browser needs: mount, zoom, lazy loading, window, entry points
